title: Seahawks' Mike Macdonald gives Sam Darnold vote of confidence after turnover-riddled start: 'He's definitely part of the solution'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks' Mike Macdonald gives Sam Darnold vote of confidence after turnover-riddled start: 'He's definitely part of the solution'
sources.description: Darnold quarterbacked Seattle to a Super Bowl victory in his first season with the franchise, but he's thrown a league-high seven interceptions in five appearances this time around.
